llm.headline: Claude Opus 4.7 launches with 1M context and high-res vision
llm.detail: Anthropic releases Opus 4.7 - adaptive thinking only, sampling parameters removed, 2576px vision. Most capable Claude yet.

gpu.headline: NVIDIA B300 pricing leaked - $35K per unit
gpu.detail: Tom's Hardware reports leaked B300 pricing ahead of Q3 availability. 50% more HBM than B200.

cloud.headline: AWS us-east-1 elevated errors for 47 minutes
cloud.detail: DynamoDB and Lambda affected. RCA pending. Third incident this quarter.

pakistan.headline: PTA approves Starlink license - rollout Q4 2026
pakistan.detail: After months of regulatory review, PTA grants conditional license. Rural areas first, urban later.

security.headline: Critical RCE in popular npm package affects 12M downloads/week
security.detail: CVE-2026-XXXX allows remote code execution via crafted package.json. Patch available.

dev.headline: Claude Code 2.2 ships with worktree isolation and background agents
dev.detail: New release adds git worktree support for parallel agent work. Background tasks no longer block the main loop.
